decisive_items: positive myositis panel for anti-SAE antibodies
skin biopsy results were consistent with Wong-type presentation
response.rationale: Dermatomyositis uniquely combines the heliotrope rash, anti-SAE antibodies, and Wong-type skin biopsy with muscle weakness and elevated creatine kinase. Polymyositis explains the myopathy but not the rash; Sjögren's and autoimmune hepatitis lack the myositis and skin findings.

rejected.why: Only anti-Sjögren antibodies; no rash or myopathy.
Duplicate of Sjögren's; lacks the dermatomyositis-specific rash and myositis panel.
RA-associated ILD explains lung nodules but not the heliotrope rash or myositis.
Polymyositis explains weakness and CK but not the characteristic rash or skin biopsy.
Autoimmune hepatitis explains transaminases but not the rash, myopathy, or anti-SAE antibodies.
